transforms.assembly: Every node is exported with an identity transform; mesh vertices are authored in place in motor coordinates, so the assembled pose is the identity and every pivot lies on the shaft axis (+X towards the drive end, +Y up, +Z front, metres). The studio places the whole motor at y = 0.138 m on the bench (shaft height 132 mm plus a 6 mm mat).
transforms.explode: Per node: offset (metres) reached over a window of the 0-1 slider, smoothstep eased. fan-cover [-0.30,0,0] 0-0.4; fan [-0.20,0,0] 0.1-0.5; end-shield-nde [-0.13,0,0] 0.2-0.6; bearing-nde [-0.06,0,0] 0.25-0.65; terminal-box-lid [0,0.10,0] 0-0.35; terminal-box [0,0.05,0] 0.05-0.4; end-shield-de [0.33,0,0] 0.15-0.55; bearing-de [0.27,0,0] 0.2-0.6; rotor-assembly [0.24,0,0] 0.45-1; housing, stator-core and stator-windings stay fixed. Positions are recomputed from the assembly every frame (studio/src/engineering/motorModel.ts).
transforms.spin: Rotation about the shaft axis only: spin 'rotor' turns with the demonstration's rotor angle, 'bearing-cage' at 0.4 times it. Outer bearing rings, stator and housing never rotate.

cameraPresets.fit: Each preset frames the current model bounds exactly for the viewport (studio/src/engineering/MotorScene.tsx fitDistance, margin 1.12); Focus on part frames that part's current bounds (margin 1.7).

timings.reducedMotion: explode and camera snap (0 ms); operation never starts by itself
timings.operatingDemo: field turns at 0.25 rev/s at 1x playback; rotor drawn 20 % slower (exaggerated slip); playback 0.25x to 2x; Step advances 30 electrical degrees
